_comment: Merge this into your project .claude/settings.json to enable the orchestrator-questions extension hooks.

hooks.command: echo '[orchestrator] Sub-agent about to be spawned — ensure questions were asked first.'

node -e "const s=require('fs').existsSync; if(s('.orchestrator-questions.json')){const q=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.orchestrator-questions.json','utf8'));const pending=q.filter(x=>!x.answered);if(pending.length>0)console.log('[orchestrator] '+pending.length+' question(s) still unanswered when turn stopped.');}" 2>/dev/null || true
